title: Embryology: bud signals, hepatoblast fate and Alagille syndrome
guide: The 3 to 4 week endodermal bud from the ventral foregut with FGF from cardiogenic mesoderm and BMP 7 from the septum transversum, the cranial and caudal bud derivatives, E-cadherin loss, HNF-4 alpha versus SOX-9 with CK8 and CK18, the cytokeratin note, and the Alagille pathway defect with its facies, eye, cardiac, vertebral and renal features.

title: Derivatives, lobule structure and the cirrhosis chain
guide: The four-row derivatives table, the lobule as structural and functional unit, portal tract contents with the 70 over 40 and 30 over 60 blood and oxygen split, the anterior to vein and left of bile duct note, the vein escaping Glisson's capsule, and the replaced-by-nodules chain.

title: Acinar zones, vitelline vein fates and lobe division lines
guide: Zone 1 periportal with Wilson's disease, zone 2 mid-zonal with yellow phosphorous, zone 3 centrilobular with ischemia and paracetamol, the canal of Hering and terminal hepatic vein labels, the four-way vitelline vein chart, and the falciform ligament versus Cantlie's line.

title: Hepatocyte membrane domains and the liver disorders table
guide: Contiguous, canicular and sinusoidal domains, MRP-2 with ABCC2 and Dubin-Johnson, the stellate cell in the space of Disse storing vitamin A and driving myofibroblasts through TGF-beta, and the vascular, parenchymal and biliary rows of the disorders table.
